data.title: Ethereum devs schedule Glamsterdam upgrade for Hoodi testnet on Dec. 15
data.description:
Ethereum (ETH) core developers agreed on Thursday to move forward with the Glamsterdam upgrade under its existing specification and set activation on the Hoodi testnet for Dec. 15, 2026, at 19:12 UTC. The upgrade became active on the Sepolia testnet last month.

The decision, which came out of an all-core devs consensus (ACDC) meeting, advances the major Ethereum upgrade one step closer to public testnet deployment. A mainnet activation date was not established.

Execution layer teams reached rough consensus to ship EIP-8037 without further changes, despite earlier concerns over its potential impact on existing smart contracts and gas accounting practices.

EIP-8037, State Creation Gas Cost Increase, sharply raises the gas cost of creating new state on Ethereum and meters that cost separately from normal execution gas. This proposal aims to allow Ethereum to scale execution capacity without making it substantially harder to run nodes.

On the consensus layer, the group decided to adopt a non-consensus-breaking method (PR 5770) for validating builder payloads, which uses RLP for block-hash checks. This was chosen over another approach, PR 5820, which would have required a consensus change.

Glamsterdam is Ethereum’s next major network upgrade after Fusaka, which went live on mainnet in December 2025. The name combines the consensus-layer portion, Gloas, with the execution-layer portion, Amsterdam.

Glamsterdam's two headline upgrades are enshrined proposer-builder separation (ePBS, EIP-7732), which moves the split between block proposers and builders into the protocol itself, and block-level access lists (BALs, EIP-7928), which record the state each block touches so clients can process transactions in parallel.

Discussing Quantum-readiness

The core developers also discussed the subsequent Ethereum upgrade, Hegotá. Fork Choice Enforced Inclusion Lists (FOCIL), which would strengthen Ethereum's censorship resistance by making it more difficult for block builders to exclude valid transactions, remains Hegotá's headliner feature.

Participants in the call debated whether FOCIL should remain in that role or be scaled back to direct more resources toward post-quantum preparations.

While positions among client teams differed, Ethlabs' Co-founder Caspar Schwarz-Schilling was the most explicit voice calling for an exclusive focus on post-quantum work. Earlier this month, Ethlabs proposed accelerating Ethereum’s post-quantum, post-AI (PQAI) readiness to 2027 from its current target of 2029, citing AI's role in compressing cryptographic risk timelines.

"I think, really, the question is whether we are going to reprioritize Hegotá and basically drop everything that’s not on the critical path to post-quantum or not," the Ethlabs researcher said during the meeting. "In my opinion, it’s just that quite obvious that we should be uncompromisingly prioritizing PQAI at this point, and kind of drop FOCIL."

No final decision was made during the meeting, and the full Hegotá scope is scheduled for review on the next call in roughly two weeks.

data.title: French minister pitches Franco-Italian air defence system to Swiss
data.description:
Switzerland could benefit from closer industrial and military cooperation if it chooses the Franco-Italian SAMP/T NG air defence system, French Defence Minister Catherine Vautrin was quoted as saying on Friday ahead of discussions with Bern.

"Procuring SAMP/T NG would allow Switzerland to build up the necessary maintenance capacity in its own country and thus secure its operational autonomy in the long term," Vautrin told Switzerland's Neue Zuercher Zeitung newspaper.

Vautrin, who is meeting Swiss counterpart Martin Pfister in Bern on Friday, said deliveries could start as soon as 2029, depending on when Switzerland made a decision.

Switzerland is considering both the SAMP/T NG — produced by a Franco-Italian Eurosam consortium that includes MBDA France, MBDA Italy and Thales — and Israel's Barak MX as it seeks to acquire a new ground-based air defence system.

The government has said it aims to make a decision on the system, which should complement Switzerland's plans to acquire a US Patriot missile defence system, early in 2027.

Vautrin said the previous SAMP/T version had proved itself in Ukraine and that French companies could provide effective systems quickly and at competitive prices.

She added that SAMP/T NG would need continuous development to address future threats, such as by integrating new sensors, which could create potential opportunities for Swiss companies.

"In this context it's entirely conceivable that Switzerland, with its highly capable industrial sector, could participate in the development of new capabilities," she said.

When asked what it would mean if Swiss voters opted not to loosen curbs on weapons exports in a referendum on Sunday, Vautrin said it could reduce opportunities for industrial collaboration.

Vautrin said France and Switzerland would sign a declaration of intent on cooperation on defence and the space sector.

data.title: Cereno Scientific gives notice to attend Extraordinary General Meeting
data.description:
The shareholders of Cereno Scientific AB (publ), reg. no. 556890-4071, (the “Company”) are hereby given notice to attend the Extraordinary General Meeting to be held on Tuesday 15 December 2026 at 2:00 p.m. at MAQS Advokatbyrå AB’s premises at Masthamnsgatan 13 in Gothenburg, Sweden. Registration for the general meeting will commence at 1:30 p.m. Registration of participation at the general meeting will be canceled when the general meeting opens.

Right to participate at the general meeting

Any shareholder wishing to participate at the general meeting must:

  • be entered in the share register maintained by Euroclear Nordics AB as per Monday 7 December 2026 and, if the shares are nominee-registered, request that the nominee register the voting rights no later than Wednesday 9 December 2026; and
  • provide notice of their intention to participate at the general meeting in accordance with the instructions under the heading “Notification of participation in person or by proxy”, in such time that the notice is received by the Company no later than Wednesday 9 December 2026.

Notification of participation in person or by proxy

Shareholders who wish to attend the general meeting in person or by proxy shall notify the Company no later than Wednesday 9 December 2026 in one of the following ways:

  • by e-mail to info@cerenoscientific.com; or
  • by letter addressed to Cereno Scientific AB, Förändringens gata 10, 431 53 Mölndal, Sweden (mark the envelope “EGM14 2026”).

The notice must include the shareholder’s name, address, telephone number, personal identification number or company registration number as well as the number of attendees (no more than two (2)).

Shareholders who wish to be represented by a proxy must issue a written and dated Power of Attorney for the proxy. Power of Attorney forms may be obtained through the Company and will also be available on the Company's website, www.cerenoscientific.com. The Power of Attorney should, if possible, be submitted in original to the Company at the above-stated address in due time prior to the general meeting. Representatives of legal entities must include a copy of the current Certificate of Registration or other applicable documents.

Nominee-registered shares

To be entitled to participate at the general meeting, shareholders who have caused their shares to be registered with a nominee must request that they be temporarily registered in their own name in the shareholders’ register maintained by Euroclear Nordics AB. Such temporary registration of voting rights carried out by the nominee no later than Wednesday 9 December 2026 will be taken into account in the preparation of the share register. This means that the shareholder must notify the nominee of their wish for voting rights registration in due time in accordance with the nominee’s procedures.

Business on the general meeting

Proposed agenda:

  • Opening of the general meeting;
  • Election of chairperson of the general meeting;
  • Preparation and approval of the voting register;
  • Election of one or two persons to verify the minutes;
  • Determination of whether the general meeting has been duly convened;
  • Approval of the agenda;
  • Determination of the number of directors and deputy directors;
  • Election of the Board of Directors;
  • Election of chairperson of the Board of Directors;
  • Resolution regarding adjustment authorization;
  • Closing of the general meeting.

Proposed resolutions by the Board of Directors

2. Election of chairperson of the general meeting

The Board of Directors proposes lawyer Eric Ehrencrona, or, in the event of an impediment, the person appointed by the Board of Directors to be elected as the chairperson of the general meeting.

10. Resolution regarding adjustment authorization

The Board of Directors, the CEO or the person appointed by the Board of Directors, shall be authorized to make such minor amendments of the resolution by the general meeting that may prove necessary in connection with registration of the resolutions.

Proposed resolutions by the Nomination Committee

In accordance with the principles adopted by the Annual General Meeting, the Nomination Committee shall consist of one member appointed by the Company’s largest shareholder, or group of shareholders, as per 30 June 2026, the chairperson of the Board of Directors, and Björn Dahlöf, Chief Scientific Officer (CSO) in the Company. The Nomination Committee therefore consists of Andreas Ejlegård (appointed by the Company’s largest group of shareholders), Anders Svensson and Björn Dahlöf.

The Nomination Committee’s work on the proposals for resolutions under items 7–9 of the agenda has not yet been completed. The proposed resolutions under these items will be announced in a separate press release as soon as the work has been completed.

Number of shares and votes

The total number of shares and votes in the Company on the date of this notice is 722,248 shares of series A with ten votes each, and 323,129,781 shares of series B with one vote each, which means that the total number of shares in the Company amounts to 323,852,029 and the total number of votes in the Company amounts to 330,352,261. The Company holds no treasury shares.

Other

The shareholders are reminded of the right to, at the general meeting, request information from the Board of Directors and the CEO in accordance with Chapter 7, Section 32 of the Swedish Companies Act.

Documents to be considered at the general meeting will be available at the Company’s office at Cereno Scientific AB, Förändringens gata 10, 431 53 Mölndal, Sweden, and on the Company’s website, www.cerenoscientific.com, no later than two (2) weeks prior to the general meeting. The documents are also forwarded free of charge to the shareholders who request them and provide their address.

Processing of personal data

Personal data retrieved from the share register maintained by Euroclear Nordics AB, notifications, and participation at the meeting, as well as information about representatives, proxies, and assistants, will be used for registration, preparation of the voting list for the meeting, and, where applicable, the meeting minutes. The personal data is handled in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council). For complete information on how personal data is processed, please see the privacy policy available on Euroclear's website, www.euroclear.com/dam/ESw/Legal/Privacy-notice-bolagsstammor-engelska.pdf.

Gothenburg in November 2026

Cereno Scientific AB (publ)

The Board of Directors

The English version of the notice is an uncertified translation of the Swedish version and in the event of any inconsistency between the English notice and the Swedish notice, the Swedish version shall prevail.

For further information, please contact:

Tove Bergenholt, Head of IR & Communications

Email: tove.bergenholt@cerenoscientific.com

Phone: +46 73- 236 62 46

About Cereno Scientific AB

Cereno Scientific is pioneering treatments to enhance and extend life. The company’s innovative pipeline offers disease-modifying drug candidates to empower people suffering from rare cardiovascular and pulmonary diseases to live life to the fullest.

Lead candidate CS1 is an HDAC inhibitor that works through epigenetic modulation and represents a novel therapeutic approach by targeting the underlying mechanisms of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). CS1 is a well-tolerated oral therapy with a favorable safety profile that has shown encouraging efficacy signals in a Phase IIa trial in patients with PAH, including improvements in right heart function, functional class, risk score and patient quality of life, with early signs consistent with reverse vascular remodeling. An Expanded Access Program confirmed CS1 to be well-tolerated with a favorable safety profile over 12 months of treatment and showed that a majority of patients completing treatment maintained or improved clinical status. CS1 is currently being evaluated in EPIMODE, a global, placebo-controlled Phase IIb trial in PAH. CS014 is a new chemical entity and HDAC inhibitor with a multimodal mechanism of action as an epigenetic modulator having the potential to address the underlying pathophysiology of a range of cardiovascular and pulmonary diseases with high unmet needs. CS014 showed a favorable safety and tolerability profile in Phase I, and is being advanced through a streamlined, FDA-aligned pathway toward Phase IIb in pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD). Cereno Scientific is also advancing the preclinical program CS585, an oral, highly potent and selective prostacyclin (IP) receptor agonist shown to prevent thrombosis without increased bleeding risk, currently being evaluated in antiphospholipid syndrome (APS).

The Company is headquartered in GoCo Health Innovation City in Gothenburg, Sweden, and has a US subsidiary, Cereno Scientific Inc., located in Kendall Square, Boston. Cereno Scientific is listed on the Nasdaq First North (CRNO B). The Company’s Certified Adviser is DNB Carnegie Investment Bank AB, certifiedadviser@carnegie.se. data.title: BEML shares at 52-week high after 17% jump marks biggest single-day gain since 2024
data.description:
Shares of state-run BEML surged nearly 17% and hit a fresh 52-week high on Friday, November 27. This is the stock's biggest single-day gain since June 14, 2024, when it had risen 17.1%. The stock has risen in four of the last six trading sessions.

BEML shares have risen 18.1% in November, so far. This is its biggest monthly gain since April this year, when the stock had jumped nearly 32%. The stock has risen for a total of five of the past 11 months of 2026.

BEML reported its second quarter results earlier this month. Its net profit declined 31.1% to ₹33.3 crore from ₹48.3 crore last year. Its revenue was up 42.1% at ₹1,192 crore from ₹839 crore in the second quarter last fiscal.

The company's earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBTIDA) increased 14.3% to ₹80 crore from ₹70 crore in the previous year. Its EBITDA margin contracted to 6.7% from 8.7% in the year-ago period.

The company also raised its FY27 revenue growth outlook to over 35% from its previous guidance of 30%. The company's chairman and managing director told CNBC-TV18 that the firm is confident of achieving its full-year double-digit EBITDA margin guidance, with improved execution in the third and fourth quarters, supported by a favourable product mix.

The company's order book stood around ₹21,000 crore at the end of the first half of this fiscal, supported largely by rail and metro projects.

All seven analysts who have coverage on the BEML stock have "buy" recommendations and have set target prices in the range of ₹2,201 to ₹3,040 apiece. This indicates an upside of 7.88% to 49%.

Shares of BEML gained 16.55% to hit an intraday and fresh 52-week high of ₹2,378 apiece on Friday. It has gained 18.5% in the past month and 29.2% in the last six months.

data.title: French preliminary inflation at 3.2% in November
data.description:
French consumer prices rose more slowly than expected in November, preliminary data from the INSEE statistics agency showed on Friday.

France's harmonized inflation rate, adjusted for comparison with other euro zone countries, was 3.2% year-on-year in November, slowing from 3.7% in October, as a rise in energy prices is expected to have tempered, held back by a sharp slowdown in oil product prices, despite an acceleration in gas prices.

  • A Reuters poll of 15 analysts had on average expected a rate of 3.6%, with estimates ranging from 3.4% to 3.9%

  • France's domestic consumer price index rose 2.9% year-on-year in November, below the 3.2% forecast and down from 3.4% in October

  • Services inflation is seen to have declined, led by a sharp slowdown in prices of accommodation and transport services

  • Food prices are expected to have accelerated slightly, led by fresh products, while tobacco price inflation is seen to have slowed very slightly

data.title: Oil Prices Rise Ahead of OPEC+ Meeting as Middle East Supply Risks Persist
data.description:
By Farhan Rafid

DOHA, Qatar--Oil prices rose Friday as traders weighed renewed threats to Middle Eastern supplies ahead of a meeting of OPEC and its allies this weekend.

Front-month Brent crude futures were up 0.6% at $97.15 a barrel, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate rose 2.7% to $85.96 a barrel.

Both benchmarks are on track for their first weekly gain this month as geopolitical risks in the Middle East intensify, analysts at MUFG said in a note.

The premium of front-month Brent futures over the following month's contract has widened to $4.28 a barrel from around $2.50 at the start of the week, the analysts said. The impact of Sunday's OPEC+ meeting on oil prices is likely to be tempered by the outlook for the regional conflict, they added.

Saudi Arabia's energy ministry said Thursday that an attack on the Jazan oil refinery sparked a fire and temporarily halted some operations, with one worker killed and several others injured. Authorities were assessing the damage and checking the safety of the facilities, the ministry said.

Meanwhile, a drone attack in Kuwait killed two Italian technicians, The Wall Street Journal reported. Iran denied responsibility for the attack, which came as negotiations between Washington and Tehran remained deadlocked despite a ceasefire.

The Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries and other producers in the broader OPEC+ group are expected to discuss their collective output policy for 2027 on Sunday, with existing production agreements set to expire at the end of this year.

The group's assessment of members' sustainable production capacities will help determine individual output quotas for next year. However, disruptions to production and exports during the Iran war have complicated efforts to establish how much individual countries can pump.

It remains unclear whether Saudi Arabia--the cartel's de facto leader--and other members will restore more supply, maintain current restrictions or consider fresh cuts to support prices.

Write to Farhan Rafid at farhan.rafid@wsj.com

data.title: EQT to Buy Majority Stake in Specialty European Pharmaceutical Group Kelso Pharma
data.description:
By Dominic Chopping

Swedish buyout group EQT said it agreed to acquire a majority stake in specialty pharmaceutical group Kelso Pharma from healthcare-investment firm Apposite Capital.

Founded in 2021, Kelso Pharma is a European group with a portfolio of around 14 medicines, mainly for endocrine, gastrointestinal and central nervous system conditions. They are sold through its own U.K.-based commercial infrastructure and exported to more than 30 countries globally.

Kelso Pharma is working to expand the product range to provide additional medicines. EQT said it would support the pharmaceutical company's expansion across Europe through investment in its commercial capabilities, new product launches and selective acquisitions and licensing agreements.

Kelso's management team, led by Chief Executive Officer Tom Stratford, will continue to lead the company.

"Healthcare systems across Europe are increasingly looking to specialist companies to serve patient groups that larger pharmaceutical businesses often overlook," said Mark Braganza, partner at EQT Healthcare Growth.

"With an experienced team, its own commercial infrastructure and a portfolio serving niche patient populations, Kelso has built a strong U.K.-based business with the foundations to grow as a pan-European platform."

The deal is expected to close during the first quarter of 2027, subject to customary conditions and approvals.

data.title: The Coca-Cola Company and Gutsche Family Investments Close on Sale of Controlling Interest in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa to Coca-Cola HBC AG
data.description:
The Coca-Cola Company and Gutsche Family Investments (GFI) have completed the sale of a 75% controlling interest in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa Pty. Ltd. (CCBA) to Coca-Cola HBC AG.

The proposed transaction was first announced in October 2025. The companies closed on Nov. 27 after receiving all necessary regulatory approvals in Africa.

Coca-Cola and Coca-Cola HBC have a separate option agreement providing Coca-Cola HBC the opportunity to acquire the remaining 25% stake in CCBA held by Coca-Cola within a six-year period.

CCBA is the largest Coca-Cola bottler in Africa, operating in 14 countries. Following completion of the deal, Coca-Cola HBC is the second-largest Coca-Cola bottler globally by volume, extending its footprint to 43 markets and serving approximately 1.2 billion consumers across Europe and Africa.

Advancing Coca-Cola's Refranchising Strategy

The completion of the transaction marks another significant milestone in Coca-Cola's ongoing strategy to refranchise company-owned and controlled bottling operations.

“This transaction reflects the strength of the Coca-Cola system and our long-term commitment to building locally led, world-class bottling operations,” said Henrique Braun, CEO of The Coca-Cola Company. “CCBA has established a strong foundation across Africa, and Coca-Cola HBC brings proven capabilities, deep market expertise and a successful track record of investing for sustainable growth.”

Luis Felipe Avellar, president of the Africa operating unit of The Coca Cola Company, said, “We are confident this combination will create new opportunities for customers, consumers and communities across the continent. Coca-Cola HBC is a strong, valued partner that has the ability to grow our business in Africa.”

The Gutsche family will remain connected to the Coca-Cola system and Africa through its ownership stake in Coca-Cola HBC.

Strengthening Coca-Cola HBC’s Presence in Africa

The acquisition builds on Coca-Cola HBC’s origins in Nigeria 75 years ago and its expansion into Egypt in 2022. Following completion of the acquisition, Coca-Cola HBC now represents approximately two-thirds of Africa’s total Coca-Cola system volume and serves more than half of the continent’s population. The combination creates a stronger platform to share capabilities, invest in people and infrastructure, and drive sustainable, profitable growth.

Zoran Bogdanovic, CEO of Coca-Cola HBC, said: “Today we mark a historic milestone as we complete the acquisition of CCBA. Africa is where Coca-Cola HBC began 75 years ago, and this acquisition significantly strengthens our presence across this incredible continent, creating a strong platform for sustainable, profitable growth. Our listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange this week further underlines our long-term commitment to South Africa and the broader African continent.

“CCBA is a high-quality business with strong market positions, deep local knowledge and talented people. We are very pleased to welcome our new colleagues to Coca-Cola HBC. Together, we will invest in our leading 24/7 portfolio, our bespoke capabilities and our passionate people to capture the significant opportunities ahead.

“I would like to thank The Coca-Cola Company and the Gutsche family for their trust and partnership, and our teams across CCBA, Coca-Cola HBC and the wider Coca-Cola system for their commitment in completing this transaction. We look forward to working together to drive joint success.”

As part of the transaction, Coca-Cola sold 41.52% of its 66.52% stake in CCBA to Coca-Cola HBC, while Coca-Cola HBC acquired the 33.48% stake held by GFI.

Rothschild & Co. acted as sole financial adviser to Coca-Cola. Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE, Amsterdam Branch and UBS AG London Branch acted as financial advisers to Coca-Cola HBC. Nomura International acted as sole financial adviser to GFI.

About The Coca-Cola Company

The Coca-Cola Company () is a total beverage company with products sold in more than 200 countries and territories. Our company’s purpose is to refresh the world and make a difference. We sell multiple billion-dollar brands across several beverage categories worldwide. Our portfolio of sparkling soft drink brands includes Coca-Cola, Sprite and Fanta. Our water, sports, coffee and tea brands include Dasani, smartwater, vitaminwater, Topo Chico, BODYARMOR, Powerade, Costa, Georgia, Fuze Tea, Gold Peak and Ayataka. Our juice, value-added dairy and plant-based beverage brands include Minute Maid, Simply, innocent, Del Valle, fairlife and Santa Clara. We’re constantly transforming our portfolio, from reducing sugar in our drinks to bringing innovative new products to market. We seek to positively impact people’s lives, communities and the planet through water replenishment, packaging recycling, sustainable sourcing practices and carbon emissions reductions across our value chain. Together with our bottling partners, we employ more than 700,000 people, helping bring economic opportunity to local communities worldwide. Learn more at www.coca-colacompany.com and follow us on Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn.

About Coca-Cola HBC AG

Coca-Cola HBC is a growth-focused consumer packaged goods business and strategic bottling partner of The Coca-Cola Company. Our business was founded in Nigeria in 1951, and this year we celebrate our 75th anniversary. We open up moments that refresh us all, by creating value for our stakeholders and supporting the socio-economic development of the communities in which we operate. With a vision to be the leading 24/7 beverage partner, we offer drinks for all occasions around the clock. Following the completion of our acquisition of a majority stake in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa on 27 November 2026, we work together with our customers to serve more than 1.2 billion consumers across 43 markets in Europe and Africa.

Our portfolio is one of the strongest, broadest and most flexible in the beverage industry, with consumer-leading brands across the sparkling, adult sparkling, juice, water, sport, energy, ready-to-drink tea, coffee, and premium spirits categories, with snacks as an additional offering. Our products include Coca-Cola, Coca-Cola Zero Sugar, Fanta, Sprite, Schweppes, Kinley, Costa Coffee, Caffè Vergnano, Valser, Romerquelle, Dasani and other water brands, FuzeTea, Powerade, Cappy, Monster Energy, Finlandia Vodka, The Macallan, Jack Daniel's and Plazma. We foster an open and inclusive work environment for approximately 50,000 employees and believe that a positive environmental impact is integral to our future growth. We are among the leaders of the global beverage industry across major sustainability benchmarks, including the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Indices, CDP, MSCI ESG, FTSE ESG and ISS ESG.

Coca-Cola HBC is listed on the London Stock Exchange (), Euronext Athens (Euronext Athens: EEE) and the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (). For more information, please visit https://www.coca-colahellenic.com

data.title: Altria, Imperial Brands Merger Could Face U.S. Antitrust Concerns — Market Talk
data.description: A merger between Altria and Imperial Brands is likely to face U.S. antitrust concerns as the combined company would have over a 50% market share, Citi's Simon Hales and Sunny Wadhwani write. However, selling Imperial's U.S. combustible cigarette assets to a third party--such as Japan Tobacco--could resolve the issue. "There is considerable strategic logic for a deal from Altria's standpoint as it would diversify its footprint and provide it with much needed scale in NGPs," the analysts say. Citi has a neutral rating on Altria's stock and a $72.00 target price. Altria's shares closed Wednesday at $76.28 and U.S. markets were closed Thursday for the Thanksgiving holiday. Imperial Brands' shares closed 13% higher at 34.32 pounds on Thursday, marking their highest price since July 2017. (ian.walker@wsj.com)

data.title: South African rand strengthens on precious metals rally
data.description:
The South African rand strengthened in early trade on Friday, supported by a rally in precious metals, although risk appetite was limited.

  • At 0726 GMT the rand traded at 17.3701 against the dollar , about 1% up from its previous close

  • Gold prices, a major support for South Africa's export sector, rebounded from a more than one-year low on Friday, while platinum gained nearly 5%

  • "The rand has started Friday on the front foot...as a recovery in tech and AI-related shares and stronger precious metal prices offer some relief," said Wichard Cilliers, head of Market Risk at TreasuryONE

  • With the dollar near a 22-month high and markets expecting a December Fed rate hike, he said risk sentiment was fragile and the rand was likely to stay volatile in the coming weeks

  • On the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, the Top-40 index was last up 2.2% in early trade

  • South Africa's benchmark 2035 government bond (ZAR2035=) was slightly firmer in early deals, as the yield fell 3 basis points to 8.67%

data.title: South Korean shares end week higher on hopes of policy support
data.description:
Key points:
  • KOSPI rises, foreigners net buyers
  • Korean won strengthens against dollar
  • South Korea benchmark bond yield rises
  • For the midday report, please clicknL2N47801P

Round-up of South Korean financial markets:

** South Korean shares rose more than 4% on Friday to end a week of heightened volatility with gains, supported by hopes of policy measures to stabilise the market.

** The benchmark KOSPI closed up 204.47 points, or 4.34%, at 4,915.68.

** For the week, it rose 0.9%, after dropping 7.9% last week.

** Earlier this week, the KOSPI hit the lowest level since mid-January on persistent worries about a slowdown in the global AI investment boom, prompting policymakers to consider deploying market stabilisation funds.

** South Korea's finance minister, Lee Hyoung-il, again vowed on Friday to remain prepared to take necessary measures depending on market conditions.

** "Hopes of financial authorities rolling out market stabilisation funds had upward pressure on the stock market," said Lee Kyoung-min, an analyst at Daishin Securities.

** "We believe that the Securities Market Stabilization Fund could be revised up to 20-40 trillion won, versus the current 10.76 trillion won ($8.01 billion)," Citi economist Kim Jin-wook said, expecting the fund to be utilised as early as next month.

** Chipmaker Samsung Electronics rose 4.55%, while peer SK Hynix gained 5.41%.

** Among other index heavyweights, battery maker LG Energy Solution climbed 4.80%, while Hyundai Motor and sister automaker Kia Corp were up 3.86% and up 1.07%, respectively.

** Of the total 908 traded issues, 783 shares advanced, while 109 declined.

** Foreigners were net buyers of shares worth 1.1 trillion won ($822.68 million).

** The won was quoted at 1,336.6 per dollar on the onshore settlement platform , 0.55% higher than its previous close at 1,343.9.

** The most liquid three-year Korean treasury bond yield (KR3YT=RR) rose by 6.1 basis points to 3.687%, while the benchmark 10-year yield rose by 2.2 basis points to 3.798%.

($1 = 1,337.1000 won)
